messages:
sara (product): Heads-up — intake from Acero. They want private deployment (VPC/on‑prem) with HSM integration and a 2-week install window. Can we triage feasibility and major deps?

marta (eng): Need infra inventory: OS, kernel, k8s distro/version, container runtime, firewall rules. HSM vendor + PKCS#11 details.

aj (infra): We'll need outgoing access to registry endpoints + nginx pull endpoints, or a mirrored registry. Also clarify whether they provide GPUs or want our appliance. For VPC peering we need routable CIDR and allowed ports (443, 22, 10250).

david (sales): Customer notes: willing to sign enterprise + 12mo support. Wants end-of-Q2 go-live but flexible on staging. They're also asking for SSO + audit logs.

kevin (solutions): Can you confirm HSM model? Some HSMs require host-level drivers which complicates air-gapped installs.

marta (eng): FYI — Acero's HSM (per initial intake) is a Thales variant; driver only supported on >=5.10 kernels. If customer's infra is older we need either kernel upgrade or sidecar driver approach.

sara (product): If we get inventory within 5 business days can PM estimate effort. Rough ask: minimal MVP in 6w if no kernel or custom driver work.

aj (infra): 6w is OK for VPC + standard on‑prem if they supply compatible nodes and we don't need custom kernels. Custom driver work adds ~3–4w and requires security sign-off.

deploy-bot: New intake created — ticket INT-2987 assigned to product-triage.

david (sales): I'll collect the infra inventory today and send to @kevin and @marta. Also flagging SSO requirement (SAML) to legal.

kevin (solutions): I'll draft SLA addendum & install window options, share by EOD. :thumbsup:

marta (eng): Add tech note: need to validate KV cache persistence semantics in airgap (kvsync) and fallback routing for model variants when on-prem capacity limited.

sara (product): Action items — david: collect inventory; kevin: SLA addendum; marta: tech assessment + compatibility matrix. I'll add INT-2987 to backlog and put on Wed prioritization meeting. :spiral_calendar:
